highlights.headline: What’s the point? Ten years after the Paris treaty, are climate talks getting anywhere?
highlights.summary: <p>Its key temperature goal has been missed but experts say the agreement is still proving a vital moral compass for progress</p><p>It was a curious way of conducting negotiations. Ahead of the 2025 climate summit, in the Amazonian port of Belém last year, the Brazilian hosts had taken off the table the issue that most had assumed would be at its heart: concrete plans from each country laying out exactly what they would be doing to cut their greenhouse gas emissions.</p>&

items.title: South Africa's ANC facing worst-ever performance in local elections
items.description: Near-final results show South Africa's once dominant ANC will see its lowest-ever vote percentage. The party is taking the blame for shoddy municipal services, including water and electricity shortages.
